description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Token_End, which represents an end token in the HTMLPurifier library. The class extends HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag and adds a 'start' attribute referencing the token that began this node. It also includes a method 'toNode()' that throws an exception, indicating it is not supported for this token type.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_End
classes.description: Represents an end token in the HTMLPurifier tokenization process, specifically for end tags. It inherits from HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag and includes a reference to the starting token.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Method intended to convert the token to a node, but throws an exception as the operation is not supported.
